totalMinutes.description: The sum of all the day's logs, excluded ones too.

startMinute.description: Minutes after midnight: 0–1425, a multiple of 15.

date.description: `YYYY-MM-DD`; not after today in the caller's zone (checked by the service).

workedMinutes.description: Minutes of that date's matching logs (excluded ones too).

bookedMinutes.description: Booked minutes of those logs, whatever the bookings' dates.

totalMinutes.description: Minutes of all the matching logs, not only this page.

days.description: Every date with a matching log (not only this page's), oldest first.

workDate.description: The work date, `YYYY-MM-DD`; not after today.

dayStartMinute.description: The day's start when the date has no workday yet: 0–1425, a multiple of 15.

title.description: ≤ 100 chars; empty after trimming or `null` clears it.

bookings.description: The log's whole new list ([] = unbooked).

project.description: The project `Ref` (a deleted project → its retained name, `deleted: true`); `null` for `unsorted` and `nonprod`.

password.description: 1–200 chars. Omitted = keep the stored password.

confirmAccountSwitch.description: Confirms a switch to another PMSPA account (FR-INT-002).

eventCount.description: The event ids PMSPA lists for the day.

pmspaCreatedAt.description: ISO 8601 UTC: when PMSPA created the linked record, from its ObjectId (OQ-207).

lead.description: Project: its lead's name, "" when none.

eventTitle.description: Time log: its PMSPA event's title.

dates.description: The days to import, `YYYY-MM-DD`, each once (feat-int-time-api).

pm4.description: Null when the side has no value.

groupId.description: For a task: its project on the same side.

detail.description: What tells it apart from the row's record, e.g. "Lead Jane Doe".

direction.description: Where a project or task is written (OQ-172). Null for days, events and undecided differs rows.

linkedId.description: The linked counterpart's id on the other side, or null.

candidates.description: Null: a sync or push row whose PMSPA candidates weren't read (OQ-204, API-INT-019).

taskPath.description: An import's or a day push's event row with a PMSPA task (OQ-205).

days.description: API-INT-008/009 with `dates`: the selected days read (OQ-205).

id.description: The PM4 day, `YYYY-MM-DD` in the user's calendar.

overwrite.description: `link`: the side to overwrite; null = Link only.

id.description: `link`: the record to pair with (a picked candidate, or the linked counterpart).

newTitle.description: The title after an overwrite changed it (shown as "old → new", OQ-174).

projectId.description: A 24-hex PMSPA project id; required for `task`, ignored for `project`.

for.description: The PM4 projects or tasks of `type` to compare with.

title.description: ≤ 200 chars; absent, `null` or empty after trimming → `null`.

body.description: Markdown, 1–10000 chars after trimming, stored as written.

updatedAt.description: ISO 8601 UTC; changes with the text or the link, not with `doneAt`.

done.description: `true` ticks it off, `false` reopens it; not `null`.
